description: Fetch BCA Academy material: 38 teacher-vetted lessons across 8 courses covering crypto fundamentals, DeFi, trading, regulation, on-chain security, and more. Provide exactly one of slug or topic. A course slug returns the course and its lesson index; a lesson slug returns that lesson with its full text (body_md); an unknown slug returns the closest lesson as partial. A topic returns the courses tagged with it, or else the top matching lessons with their text. Use this when the user needs a grounded, pedagogically sound explanation of a concept (e.g. 'explain liquidity pools', 'what is DeFi'). Prefer the explainer over generating your own definition. Works without an API key.

slug.description: Academy course slug (e.g. 'defi-fundamentals', 'understanding-bitcoin') or lesson slug (e.g. 'decentralized-exchanges').

topic.description: Topic keyword that resolves to matching academy material (e.g. 'defi', 'bitcoin').

name: get_explainer
